title: palcheck presence oracle not extended to the new #65 sprites — a cropped/missing small_biz or campus blit passes all 10 gates
detail: palcheck exists because human golden review missed the B1 sprite-crop bug; the new canon sprites have no mechanical presence check. A degenerate blit re-blesses green T2 goldens and every gate stays green.
recommended_fix: Add the small_biz/campus canon hexes to palcheck's exact-color scan over a terminal_types golden frame (same pattern as HOUSE_ROOFS/HOST_ROOF).

title: Fallback primitive shapes for Small_Biz/Campus (E9.1 claim) have no test at any level
detail: The PR's E9.1 fallback claim is verified only by reading the code; no sheet-missing T2 golden or unit test exercises the branch. Low risk — the path is admittedly unreachable with the committed sheet.
recommended_fix: Either accept as documented-unreachable, or add a harness mode/golden that renders one frame with sprites_load forced false to pin the distinct fallback shapes.

title: W9 re-pin drops the pre-surge per-tick burst verification and leaves a stale ceiling message
detail: Old code checked per-tick burst every tick 1..SURGE_END; new code only tick>=SURGE_START. Envelope-window fix is correct and base-rate totals are pinned by test_terminal_class_profiles, but pre-surge per-tick burst is now unverified; message still says 2 while campus ceiling is 3.
recommended_fix: Keep the per-tick burst map populated for all ticks (check only inside the surge window if desired) and update the failure message to the per-type ceil_cap wording.

title: role_from_name's new "small_biz"/"campus" strings have no direct unit test — catalog_test baselines were not extended
evidence:
role_from_name :: proc(name: string) -> Terminal_Role {
	switch name {
	case "residential":  return .Residential
	case "content_host": return .Content_Host
	case "small_biz":   return .Small_Biz
	case "campus":      return .Campus
— core/catalog_test.odin:25 NT_VALID baseline lists only residential/content_host/router_basic/router_mid/router_high (no small_biz/campus); unit tests use the hand-built test_catalog mirror (determinism_test.odin:46-47) with direct enum values, bypassing role_from_name
detail: A typo in a case label surfaces only via integration (catalogs_load fail-fast "terminal without a role" / "entry unknown source_role" fails all 33 harness demos) — loud, but no unit-level trace pins the string→enum mapping.
recommended_fix: Extend NT_VALID (or add a small table row) in catalog_test.odin with small_biz/campus and assert parsed terminal_role == .Small_Biz/.Campus after catalogs_load.
